adjudication_policy.scope: QA verdicts retained; final scoring weights defined in rules.json.
adjudication_policy.qa_votes: Three new separate-context yes/no assessments using expanded audiovisual evidence. Majority of these three; historical votes retained, excluded from the new vote because source evidence and abstention policy changed.
adjudication_policy.invalid: Previously pending QA involving exhausted format/evidence failures receive zero. Any malformed/missing/nonbinary/out-of-window row in the three new assessments makes that QA zero. No format-repair resampling. Service/network failures stop work and are not treated as candidate faults.
adjudication_policy.reference: Source-only Qwen corrected English transcript, shared across all models. Three independent transcriptions per core window; if different, three evidence-grounded selection votes, fourth tie-break if necessary. No solver text is supplied. Deterministic WER formula retained.
adjudication_policy.caveat: Operational Qwen adjudication, not expert ground truth. Same model contexts are not independent human raters. Invalid-judge zero is a user-requested policy penalty, not proof that candidate content is wrong.

weight_policy.gate_policy: All existing gates retained. Failed or pending gates do not pass.
weight_policy.scope: Frozen submissions, QA answers, reasons and votes unchanged. Only aggregation weights change.
